filled.reason: GdsBadge renders white text on the accent; this is the guarantee the frozen palette bought.

outline.reason: No component renders an accent as text on the page today. Measured so a future outline mode starts with data rather than a surprise.

emoji.reason: The disc is aria-hidden decoration and the label carries the meaning; WCAG 1.4.11 does not cover it. The pair that would matter (glyph vs disc) is uncomputable for OS-rendered emoji.
